title: Navy Pier Winter Fireworks — Saturday, November 28, 2026
summary: Navy Pier opens its 2026 Winter Fireworks series on Saturday, November 28 at 8 PM with a free pyrotechnic show over Lake Michigan.
viewingTips: The south dock and East End Plaza offer the closest sightlines as shells launch over the lake. | Arrive 30–45 minutes early; winter Saturdays draw steady crowds despite the cold.
parkingTips: Navy Pier's on-site garages are the closest option; rates and capacity are posted on the official pier site. | Garage exits back up right after the finale, so linger indoors if you are driving.
transitTips: CTA's #29 State and #66 Chicago bus routes serve Navy Pier directly. | The pier is about a 15-minute walk from the Grand Red Line station — dress for lake wind.
safetyNotes: Keep clear of fenced launch zones along the dock edges and follow pier staff directions. | Lakefront wind chills drop fast after sunset; bring layers and a hat.
